Nicht alle Beiträge werden schon ausgereift sein, aber zur Weiterentwicklung ihrer Verfasser finden wir es sehr wichtig, dass auch sie öffentlich verfügbar sind, um den Austausch und die Diskussion zu ermöglichen, die die Autoren weiterbringen. Daher möchten wir dafür werben, die Texte der "Next Generation" als Entwicklungsprojekt zu verstehen und am Prozessgedanken zu messen. Einige Artikel sind bereits auf dem Level, auf der Startseite von Spielverlagerung erscheinen zu können. Eine Übersicht sämtlicher Artikel der "Next Generation" findet sich hier.

    Hoewel Nederland met een hoge laatste lijn en veel spelers rond de bal in theorie uitstekende voorwaarden creëert voor een effectieve counterpress, blijft de uitvoering wisselvallig. Na balverlies ontbreekt het nog te vaak aan directe druk op de bal. Daardoor krijgt de tegenstander regelmatig de mogelijkheid om de eerste pass vooruit te spelen voordat Nederland de controle terug heeft. Een deel van dat probleem ontstaat al tijdens het eigen balbezit. Wanneer Nederland te snel door het centrum probeert te spelen zonder eerst voldoende tegenstanders te binden, ligt de ruimte na balverlies direct open. Tunesië wist daar meerdere keren gebruik van te maken door met een numeriek overtal uit de eerste druk weg te spelen. Ook de restverdediging oogde niet altijd even stabiel. Doordat De Jong regelmatig uitzakte naast of tussen de centrale verdedigers, ontstond er soms een 4-0-structuur vóór de laatste lijn. De ruimte vóór de verdediging bleef daardoor onbezet, waardoor Tunesië na balveroveringen relatief eenvoudig de eerste pass kon versturen. Aké probeerde dat meerdere keren individueel te corrigeren door agressief door te stappen vanuit de laatste lijn. Zijn proactieve manier van verdedigen leverde verschillende balveroveringen op, maar bracht ook risico’s met zich mee. In de twaalfde minuut ontstond juist door zo’n uitstapmoment ruimte aan de buitenkant, waardoor Tunesië gevaarlijk kon omschakelen. Vergeleken met Van de Ven verdedigt Aké duidelijk aanvallender. Hij stapt sneller uit, durft vaker initiatief te nemen en wint veel duels vooruit. Tegelijkertijd vraagt die speelstijl om een perfecte onderlinge afstemming binnen de restverdediging.

    In a recent development, na rust verloor de counterpress geleidelijk aan kwaliteit. De afstanden tussen de spelers werden groter, waardoor het collectieve karakter steeds meer verdween. In plaats van gezamenlijk druk te zetten, probeerden individuele spelers het balverlies op eigen kracht te herstellen. Daardoor werd de restorganisatie minder stabiel en kreeg Tunesië vaker de mogelijkheid om onder de eerste druk uit te spelen. Ook de communicatie bij het doordekken liet in die fase te wensen over. Meerdere spelers twijfelden zichtbaar of ze moesten uitstappen of juist moesten terugvallen. Uit precies zo’n situatie ontstond uiteindelijk de corner waaruit Tunesië de aansluitingstreffer wist te maken.

    Industry observers note that van alle mogelijke tegenstanders lijkt Marokko voor Nederland tactisch misschien wel de lastigste. Wanneer de Marokkanen het dominante balbezitspel van dit WK weten te combineren met de compacte verdedigende organisatie die hen tijdens het WK van 2022 zo sterk maakte, krijgt Oranje een bijzonder lastige avond. Vooral de manier waarop Marokko numerieke overtallen creëert, voortdurend van positie wisselt en spelers tussen de linies vrij probeert te spelen, sluit aan bij de kwetsbaarheden die Nederland in de groepsfase meerdere keren heeft laten zien. Daar staat tegenover dat ook Marokko niet onkwetsbaar is. Wanneer Nederland erin slaagt de eerste pressinglijn te omspelen en optimaal gebruikmaakt van de ruimtes achter de hoog doorschuivende backs, liggen er zeker mogelijkheden in de omschakeling.

    Toch zal Oranje vooral zonder bal een vrijwel perfecte wedstrijd moeten spelen om controle te houden over de dynamische veldbezetting van Marokko. Op basis van de tot nu toe getoonde prestaties lijkt Marokko daarom eerder een zeer gelijkwaardige tegenstander dan een ploeg waar Nederland als uitgesproken favoriet aan begint.

    According to recent reports, LL ontdekte zijn fascinatie voor de inhoudelijke en tactische kant van het voetbal dankzij de vernieuwende ideeën van Thomas Tuchel bij Mainz. In de regio rond de Narrenstad deed hij al ervaring op binnen zowel het amateurvoetbal als de jeugdopleidingen van profclubs.

    It has been revealed that marokko speelt op dit WK vanuit een 1-4-2-3-1, met een duidelijk aanvallend gekozen benadering. In de opbouw ontstaat met Mazraoui als linksback een asymmetrische driemanslijn. Die lijn positioneert zich vrij dicht bij elkaar, terwijl Hakimi een soort vrije rol krijgt doordat hij hoger doorschuift of juist naar binnen komt. Met zijn lange loopacties in de diepte zorgt hij voor veel dreiging. Door de hoge positie van Hakimi kan Brahim Díaz lager aan de flank komen, of juist ver naar binnen bewegen om als verbindingsspeler tussen de linies te fungeren. De twee beweeglijke controleurs vormen een compacte dubbele zes en creëren zo een soort 1-4-2-opbouw. Ze bewegen goed getimed kort horizontaal richting de flank, maken elkaar daarbij vrij en proberen het drukzetten van de tegenstander uit te lokken om daar vervolgens met korte combinaties onderuit te spelen. Aan de linkerkant beweegt El Khannouss eveneens wat lager, zodat hij aanspeelbaar blijft voor de naar binnen gekomen Mazraoui. Hij kan ook naar binnen bewegen om zo direct mogelijk in de halfspace open te draaien richting het doel. Tegen Haïti speelde Saibari in de laatste groepswedstrijd als nominale tien. In de andere wedstrijden fungeerde hij vaker als spits vóór Ounahi, die aan beide kanten dominant als verbindingsspeler aanwezig was. Saibari, als krachtige en dynamische loper in de diepte én als uitzakkende spits, stelt iedere verdediging ter wereld voor problemen. Tegen man-georiënteerde pressing, zoals Haïti bijvoorbeeld in de hoge pressing met een simpele man-tegen-man-aanpak deed, vormt de Marokkaanse structuur zich vaak richting een 1-4-2-2-2. Daarbij wordt de breedte op de hoogste lijn bezet, terwijl de tienruimte wordt overbelast en de centrale verdedigers van de tegenstander theoretisch zonder directe tegenstander op hun eigen lijn staan. Deze veelgebruikte structuur zal ook voor Nederland in zijn man-tegen-man-aanpak een uitdaging vormen. Ook buiten de lage opbouw gebruikt Marokko uitzakkende spitsen en dus korte passafstanden en overtal rond een flankspeler. Dat is eigenlijk simpelweg een voortzetting van de lokkende overtalopbouw. Tijdens de overgang naar voren, richting het laatste derde, schuiven de tienen en spitsen weer door naar de hoogste lijn. Verbeterpotentieel laat Marokko vooral zien in de manier waarop het in het overgangsspel deze doorschuivende bewegingen aan de laatste verdedigingslijn van de tegenstander beter kan verbinden en met passes kan benutten. Tegen Haïti lukte dat nog niet goed genoeg.

    Als Nederland in het middenblok opnieuw prioriteit geeft aan het afdekken van de diepte achter de laatste lijn, dus niet met beide centrale verdedigers en backs doordekt, maar tegelijkertijd wel man-tegen-man druk wil zetten, zal Oranje waarschijnlijk voortdurend achteruit moeten verdedigen tegen Marokkaanse spelers die in de tussenruimte vrij kunnen opendraaien. Als de Marokkanen, die de flank zeer goed getimed vrijspelen en overbelasten — iets wat juist bijzonder ongunstig is voor Nederland, zoals in de vorige wedstrijden meerdere keren zichtbaar werd — er vervolgens in slagen om directer de doorschuivende bewegingen aan de laatste lijn van de tegenstander te vinden, kunnen ze Oranje tussen de linies volledig uit elkaar spelen.

    Nog gevaarlijker wordt het wanneer Marokko aan de flank of in de halfspace een ruit vormt. Binnen die structuur beweegt voortdurend een vijfde speler vrij. De speler aan de punt van de ruit zoekt met een loopactie de diepte om bijvoorbeeld de centrale verdediger en back te binden. Tegelijkertijd houdt de buitenspeler maximale breedte of komt hij juist in de bal om zijn directe tegenstander uit positie te trekken. De binnenste speler fungeert als verbindingsspeler, zodat het spel eenvoudig terug richting het centrum kan worden verlegd. De vijfde speler beweegt vervolgens precies in de ruimte die daardoor vrijkomt. Op die manier weet Marokko zich regelmatig vrij te spelen aan de flank. Van daaruit kunnen de spelers open draaien en optimaal gebruikmaken van de diagonale passlijnen die ontstaan. Dat maakt deze veldbezetting extra gevaarlijk, omdat de ploeg beschikt over meerdere creatieve dribbelaars die ook individueel een tegenstander kunnen uitspelen. Een nog groter probleem voor Oranje is dat Marokko aan beide kanten met een naar binnen gedraaide voet opbouwt. Aan de linkerkant gebeurt dat via El Khannouss en Mazraoui, aan de rechterkant via Brahim Díaz.

    Slaagt Nederland er met de eerste pressinglijn – en dan vooral met Gakpo en Malen – niet in om op tijd een 2-tegen-1 te creëren tegen Díaz en El Khannouss, dan dreigt het numerieke ondertal in het centrum de verdediging te dwingen tot slecht getimede uitstapmomenten vanuit de laatste lijn. Gebeurt dat niet, dan bestaat het risico dat Marokko simpelweg door het centrum combineert. Kiest Oranje juist voor meer ondersteuning aan de buitenkant om daar de 2-tegen-1-situaties op te lossen, dan zullen de Marokkanen dankzij hun korte passafstanden, het constante overtal in de opbouw en hun bijzonder loopsterke dubbele zes nauwelijks onder druk komen te staan. Ook het Nederlandse principe om het spel bewust van buiten naar binnen te sturen, lijkt tegen deze tegenstander eerder een nadeel dan een voordeel. De centrale kwaliteiten van Marokko, gecombineerd met de positie van Mazraoui en zijn sterke rechtervoet, sluiten daar juist uitstekend op aan. Het voortdurend uitlokken van uitstappende verdedigers, de vele overtal­situaties, de creatieve dribbelaars, de goed uitgevoerde patronen richting de flank, de constante positiewisselingen en het gebruik van spelers met een naar binnen gedraaide voet maken Marokko tot een bijzonder lastige tegenstander voor de Nederlandse defensieve organisatie. Op dat vlak zal Oranje zich waarschijnlijk moeten aanpassen.

    In a recent development, verdedigend speelt Marokko meestal vanuit een ruimtegeoriënteerd 1-4-4-2, waarbij de nummer tien naast de spits komt te spelen. Tegen Brazilië probeerden de Marokkanen de Braziliaanse opbouw bewust naar hun linkerflank te sturen. Saibari positioneerde zich daarvoor aan de rechterkant hoger tegen de linker centrale verdediger van Brazilië. Mogelijk kiezen ze tegen Nederland voor dezelfde aanpak, om Van Dijk minder opbouwopties te geven. Binnen het 1-4-4-2 verdedigt de middenlinie vooral ruimtegeoriënteerd en veel minder vanuit mandekking. Regelmatig speelt Marokko daarbij op de grens van verticale oncompactheid, met name wanneer één of beide controleurs in het drukmoment moeten doordekken. De buitenspelers, Díaz en El Khannouss, kiezen juist voor bredere uitgangsposities om direct druk te kunnen zetten aan de flank.

    Recent findings suggest that marokko onderscheidt zich de afgelopen jaren vooral door zijn defensieve intensiteit. Counterpress, sprints naar de bal, agressief doorstappen en het ondersteunen van ploeggenoten gebeuren allemaal op een hoog niveau. In combinatie met de bredere positie van de buitenspelers ontstaan daardoor kleine pressingvallen tussen de buitenspeler en de dubbele zes. Of dat volledig bewust gebeurt of niet, maakt uiteindelijk weinig uit: tegen Marokko krijg je meestal nauwelijks tijd of ruimte aan de bal. Toch kent ook deze manier van verdedigen zwakke punten. Bij het afschermen van de controleursruimte verdedigt Marokko niet altijd compact. Mazraoui stuurt El Khannouss regelmatig naar de zijkant om te voorkomen dat hij te veel ruimte moet verdedigen. Bij tweede ballen ontstaan daardoor geregeld grote gaten. Daarnaast zet de voorste lijn relatief weinig directe druk op de bal. De nadruk ligt vooral op het afsluiten van passlijnen en het sturen van de opbouw. Voor Oranje liggen daar zeker mogelijkheden, mits het de juiste pressingtriggers van Marokko weet te herkennen en te bespelen. Het overspelen van de eerste pressinglijn zou voor Nederland geen groot probleem moeten zijn. Daarna zal Oranje vooral moeten proberen de relatief zwakke linkerflank én de centrale verdedigers van Marokko aan het twijfelen te brengen: stappen ze uit of blijven ze juist staan?

    Wanneer Marokko hoger druk zet, kunnen lange ballen bovendien een effectief wapen zijn. Ook Haïti kwam op die manier tot doelpunten. De laatste lijn van Marokko laat zich namelijk al vroeg terugzakken, terwijl de balnabije backs en de middenlinie – door het beperkte drukniveau op de bal – ver moeten uitstappen om hun directe tegenstander onder druk te krijgen. Daar staat tegenover dat Marokko tegen Haïti ook een goede tactische aanpassing liet zien met een sturend 1-3-1-4-2. De grootste kwetsbaarheid van Marokko ligt echter in het gedrag van de balverre spelers na balverlies. Zij leveren zowel in de counterpress als in het terugverdedigen nauwelijks ondersteuning. Dat valt vooral op aan de rechterkant wanneer Hakimi hoog op het veld staat.

    Mocht Marokko er tijdens grote delen van de wedstrijd toch voor kiezen om terug te grijpen op de speelwijze uit het tijdperk van Regragui en te verdedigen vanuit een extreem compact en intensief 1-4-1-4-1- of 1-5-4-1-blok, dan wordt het voor Nederland bijzonder lastig om kwalitatief goede kansen te creëren. In het slechtste geval zorgt de zwakke counterpress van Oranje ervoor dat het onvoldoende dominantie kan ontwikkelen om Marokko langdurig op eigen helft vast te zetten. Daardoor zal Nederland minder tijd en balbezit rond het Marokkaanse strafschopgebied hebben en simpelweg te weinig kansen creëren om op basis van volume tot doelpunten te komen.

    Voor Nederland is Marokko misschien wel de meest ongunstige tegenstander die het op dit WK kan treffen. Wanneer Marokko het dominante balbezitspel van het WK 2026 weet te combineren met het compacte lage blok waarmee het op het WK van 2022 zoveel succes had, Saibari als spits opstelt en Bouaddi de voorkeur krijgt boven Amrabat, dan is Oranje vanuit tactisch oogpunt eerder de underdog dan de favoriet. In dat scenario lijkt uitschakeling waarschijnlijker dan plaatsing voor de volgende ronde.

    HH groeide op vlak bij de Nederlands-Duitse grens, maar liet zich voetbaltactisch vooral inspireren door Zuid-Europa. Naast zijn werkzaamheden als freelancer voor Duitse profclubs is hij sinds twee jaar actief als jeugdtrainer van de O17 van N.E.C. Nijmegen.

    Le trading constitue un levier essentiel de notre équilibre financier

    📅 25 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 2 min read (451 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Poteaux-carres

    ⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • Industry observers note that directeur Général Adjoint de l'ASSE en charge des finances du club, Fabien Dawidowicz s'exprime dans le hors série de Décideurs Corporate Finances.
    • "L'arrivée d’un actionnaire solide, ambitieux et passionné de sport comme Kilmer Sports Ventures constitue un atout.
    • In a recent development, cette prise de participation s’articule autour de trois priorités.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    Industry observers note that directeur Général Adjoint de l'ASSE en charge des finances du club, Fabien Dawidowicz s'exprime dans le hors série de Décideurs Corporate Finances. Extraits.

    "L'arrivée d’un actionnaire solide, ambitieux et passionné de sport comme Kilmer Sports Ventures constitue un atout. Au-delà de sa dimension financière, il s’agit avant tout d’un investissement patrimonial, dans un club qui fait partie du patrimoine français, voire européen. L’AS Saint-Étienne bénéficie d’une résonance internationale, notamment grâce à son histoire et à ses parcours européens dans les années 1970.

    In a recent development, cette prise de participation s’articule autour de trois priorités. La première concerne évidemment les équipes professionnelles, féminines comme masculines. La seconde porte sur les infrastructures, avec la volonté d’améliorer le centre d’entraînement et de poursuivre la modernisation du stade, en collaboration avec la Métropole de la ville. Enfin, le dernier axe, me semble crucial, car il reflète profondément l’ADN du club : c’est celui de la formation. L’académie doit permettre d’accompagner les jeunes aussi bien dans leur parcours footballistique que dans leur éducation afin de les préparer au mieux à une éventuelle carrière professionnelle.

    La baisse des droits télévisés ne signifie pas nécessairement qu’évoluer en Ligue 2 soit moins intéressant financièrement qu’en Ligue 1. Pour un club de Ligue 1 qui ne dispute pas de compétition européenne et se situe dans la deuxième partie du classement, les revenus audiovisuels peuvent être comparables à ceux d’un club de Ligue 2 de première partie de tableau, alors que les charges salariales sont généralement plus élevées dans l’élite. En échangeant récemment avec plusieurs directeurs administratifs et financiers de clubs de Ligue 1, nous avons constaté que les revenus audiovisuels d’un club classé dans le top 3 de Ligue 2 pouvaient être proches de ceux d’un club occupant la 15e place de Ligue 1.

    It has been revealed that L’enjeu est ailleurs. La Ligue 1 offre une meilleure valorisation des joueurs. Pour générer des revenus sur le marché des transferts, nous devons donc retrouver l’élite et y réaliser de bonnes performances. Cela vaut aussi bien pour les joueurs que nous recrutons et développons que pour ceux issus de notre centre de formation. Le trading de joueurs constitue ainsi un levier essentiel de notre équilibre financier.

    In a recent development, en parallèle, nous devons optimiser nos coûts d’exploitation et mieux valoriser nos actifs. C’est tout l’intérêt des investissements dans les infrastructures, autour du stade comme au centre de formation. En offrant aux joueurs de meilleures conditions d’entraînement et de développement, nous augmentons leur potentiel de performance et, à terme, leur valeur sur le marché. Ces investissements doivent donc être considérés comme un moyen de renforcer notre capacité à générer des revenus futurs.".

    Ange Postecoglou snaps at reporter as he defends Sadio Mane for missing match to be at birth of child - after defeat which saw Cristiano Ronaldo fail to score a penalty

    • Footage has emerged of Ange Postecoglou locked in a fiery exchange with a reporter after Al-Nassr's defeat to Al-Ahli - after he questioned Sadio Mane's commitment to the Saudi Pro League club.
    • The side sits third in the league standings, but were humbled in the 3-1 loss to their fourth-placed rivals on the road.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    By TAMARA PRENN, SENIOR SPORTS REPORTER.

    Published: 11:10 EST, 22 November 2026 | Updated: 04:10 EST, 23 November 2026.

    Footage has emerged of Ange Postecoglou locked in a fiery exchange with a reporter after Al-Nassr's defeat to Al-Ahli - after he questioned Sadio Mane's commitment to the Saudi Pro League club.

    The side sits third in the league standings, but were humbled in the 3-1 loss to their fourth-placed rivals on the road.

    Mane was not named in the matchday squad despite registering two assists in the club's last outing, a 6-2 victory against Asian Champions League opponents Pakhtakor FC.

    One Saudi journalist is believed to have used Mane's absence to suggest that he was not sufficiently engaged with Al-Nassr's campaign this season.

    But even the suggestion was enough to incense the former Tottenham head coach, who immediately asked if the journalist was 'a father?'.

    'Do you have children?' he queried, with the journalist responding that he did not.

    Ange Postecoglou snapped at the journalist who questioned the strength of Sadio Mane's commitment to Al-Nassr.

    Should footballers ever be criticised for choosing family over club commitments?

    The Senegal forward missed the match as he and his wife await the birth of their second child.

    'That's probably why you ask the question,' Postecoglou hit back. 'Because when you do, you'll realise it's the most crucial thing, the biggest blessing you can have.

    Sources indicate that '(Mane) is with his wife while she is having a baby, OK? Nothing is more important in life.

    'Yes, he had my permission, my blessing, and Sadio Mane is one of the best people in this world, mate.

    'Never question him or his commitment to this football club.'.

    Mane welcomed his first child with wife Aisha Timba last year, after marrying the then-18-year-old in January 2024.

    In his first match following the happy news, Mane scored and celebrated by rocking an imaginary baby in his arms.

    Postecoglou and Mane have only worked with one another since the beginning of the season, but appear to have formed a strong bond with Mane a frequent starter in the Riyadh-based starting XI.

    The Antipodean manager joined the club following a spell without work after his ignominious departure from Nottingham Forest last season.

    Since arriving in the Gulf state, Postecoglou has overseen a strong domestic campaign, with Al-Nassr registering just one previous defeat this season, against Al-Ettifaq.

    But Friday's loss may have stung all the more after Al-Nassr initially led against their bitter rivals.

    Cristiano Ronaldo had opened the scoring for the visitors on Friday evening in Jeddah, but missed a penalty striking the far post and failed to double his side's lead.

    Instead, it was Ivan Toney who was nerveless from the spot as he netted to put Al-Ahli 2-1 up in the 71st minute, with Roger Ibanez providing the winner four minutes later.

    Più squadre di Serie C, sfide secche e diritti TV: ecco le due ipotesi allo studio per il futuro della Coppa Italia.

    La Coppa Italia potrebbe cambiare volto nelle prossime tre stagioni. Nel nuovo bando per i diritti audiovisivi pubblicato dalla Lega Serie A, con scadenza al 14 dicembre, compaiono infatti due diverse formule pensate per rilanciare un torneo spesso snobbato fino alle fasi finali. A scegliere quale adottare sarà il mercato televisivo: prevarrà il format legato all'offerta economica più alta ricevuta dai broadcaster, con il via libera dell'Assemblea.

    CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

    La prima opzione, il Format "A", conferma l'impianto attuale della competizione con 44 squadre al via. Prevede solo 4 club di Serie C nel turno preliminare e l'ingresso delle prime otto classificate della passata Serie A direttamente dagli ottavi di finale con il vantaggio di giocare in casa. Sul piano economico, la Lega ha fissato una richiesta minima di 54 milioni di euro a stagione, pari a 162 milioni complessivi nel triennio. Una soluzione già collaudata che mantiene stabile la struttura del torneo e il relativo valore d'asta per le emittenti interessate.

    Recent findings suggest that il Format "B" allargherebbe il torneo a 56 squadre, portando a 16 i club di Serie C con priorità alle Seconde Squadre (Under 23) di Serie A. Tutte partirebbero subito tranne le prime otto di Serie A (dai sedicesimi), con 24 sfide secche al primo turno, possibili incroci immediati tra A e C e l'ipotesi del sorteggio per il fattore campo. Anche le semifinali sarebbero in gara secca, aggiungendo un turno senza aumentare le gare per le finaliste, mentre le Under 23 non potrebbero affrontare le rispettive Prime Squadre se non in finale. Qui la base d'asta sale a 61 milioni annui (183 milioni nel triennio), trasformando il format in una leva commerciale per i broadcaster.

    Chambaz a gagné une invitation au Musée

    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • Directeur général adjoint de l'ASSE en charge de la marque, du marketing et de la communication, Cédric Chambaz s'est confié à Sportfin France.
    • "La nostalgie, c'est quelque chose qui est paralysant.
    • Recent findings suggest that le club de l'AS Saint-Etienne est une institution aujourd'hui parce qu'il était au pic de sa performance au moment où la télévision arrive dans les foyers.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    Directeur général adjoint de l'ASSE en charge de la marque, du marketing et de la communication, Cédric Chambaz s'est confié à Sportfin France. Extraits.

    "La nostalgie, c'est quelque chose qui est paralysant. Je préfère utiliser le terme d'héritage, et un héritage, on construit dessus, on ne peut pas renier qui on est. Ça, c'est un présupposé de base. On est un club de foot d'origine populaire qui s'est construit sur une région populaire avec une classe ouvrière très forte. Saint-Etienne, c'est une région qui était minière, qui avait une industrie sidérurgique développée, etc. et qui s'est développée autour de cette industrie. Une industrie qui a depuis périclité. On a un héritage, un héritage minier, un héritage ouvrier, et de ça, aujourd'hui, dans la marque, comme dans le comportement des employés, comme dans le comportement des joueurs, on a encore des traits qui sont très forts. Il y a cette valorisation de la notion de travail. Ici il est attendu, et on le voit dans les tribunes, nos ultras, n'ont de cesse que de le répéter, il faut mouiller le maillot. C'est une expression qui est devenue consacrée, qu'on utilise comme ça, mais les premiers joueurs de l'AS Saint-Etienne, c’étaient des gens qui sortaient de la mine et qui venaient jouer au foot. Pour eux, mouiller le maillot, ce n'était pas une image, c'était une vraie attente. Et aujourd'hui, on a cet héritage-là. Donc, aujourd'hui, oui, quand on regarde sur le passé, ça a créé quelque chose de fantastique.

    Recent findings suggest that le club de l'AS Saint-Etienne est une institution aujourd'hui parce qu'il était au pic de sa performance au moment où la télévision arrive dans les foyers. Donc, on est le club que tout le monde regarde à la télé, on devient la marque de football français qui plus en gagne. C'est à une époque où le football français n'avait pas gagné depuis des décennies. Alors, on gagne jusqu'à la finale à Glasgow contre le Bayern de Munich où les fameux poteaux carrés empêchent les Dominique Rocheteau, les Jean-Michel Larqué et Jacques Santini de remporter la Ligue des champions. Mais c'est une équipe qui domine, elle a 10 titres de champion de France dans cette période-là. Donc, on est le club de foot qu'on découvre à la télé, en même temps qu'on découvre à la télé. C'est un club qui gagne, donc on s'y associe et du coup, on établit une marque très très forte, un lien émotionnel très fort. Aujourd'hui, quand on dit les Verts, dans l'inconscient collectif de partout en France, c'est forcément Saint-Etienne. Il y a un lien très fort qui émane de là, donc on ne peut pas renier ce lien-là.

    Pour autant, il ne faut pas s'y enfermer parce que sinon, on n'est pas un club de foot, on est un musée. Or aujourd'hui, les ambitions du club, c'est de retrouver ce statut sportif et de faire en sorte que l'institution et sa performance sportive soient mises en corrélation. Aujourd'hui, il y a très peu de clubs qui sont dans cette adéquation. Le Paris Saint-Germain a réussi à aligner le statut du club avec sa performance sportive. Mais quand on est par exemple, en Angleterre, un pays que je connais bien, on a des institutions du football qui ont des vraies difficultés sportives. Et pourtant, ils restent des entités respectées, reconnues comme des clubs monolithiques dans lesquels on doit un respect, une reconnaissance. Je pense à Chelsea par exemple, qui a beaucoup de mal sportivement, ils n'ont pas gagné un titre depuis des années, et pourtant… Manchester United est dans le même acabit.

    In a recent development, nous, on a cette ambition de valoriser cet héritage, de construire dessus, mais en se tournant vers l'avenir. Donc oui, on mettra en avant les Verts 76, on l'a fait l'année dernière pour le cinquantenaire de la finale de Glasgow, et on continuera de mettre en avant d'autres générations au fur et à mesure, parce que c'est sur leurs exploits qu'on a construit là où on est, mais on est définitivement tourné vers l'avenir plutôt que la glorification du passé.

    According to recent reports, du design à sa sortie, comment naît un maillot ? Déjà, c'est un travail collectif, dans lequel l'équipementier joue un rôle prépondérant. On a la chance, à l'AS Saint-Étienne, de travailler avec un équipementier qui s'appelle Hummel, avec lequel on a une relation de partenariat. Ce n'est pas toujours le cas, il y a certaines marques qui imposent au club « voilà votre maillot ». Nous, on a la chance d'être en partenariat avec Hummel et de travailler avec eux à la définition de ce maillot. Du coup, on est partie prenante du début jusqu'à la fin.

    According to recent reports, C'est un process qui dure presque 18 mois. C'est-à-dire qu'aujourd'hui, on a des conversations sur les maillots pas de la saison prochaine mais de la saison d'après. On recherche, à l'AS Saint-Étienne, des designs qui soient à la fois respectueux des codes historiques, pour cette frange de nos fans qui sont très attachés aux valeurs traditionnelles du club. On cherche aussi à pousser les limites dans d'autres secteurs. Ce qui est sûr, c'est qu'on cherchera toujours à avoir un maillot qui soit portant de sens. Donc, on va faire des références à notre territoire, à nos supporters, au club.

    Recent findings suggest that cette année, par exemple, le maillot 26-27 fait référence au premier titre de champion de France avec un design qui fait écho à celui de 1966-1967, quand le club est devenu pour la première fois champion de France, avec des bandes larges, un col blanc très large. Et quand on regarde le maillot de près, il y a un logo ASS Saint-Étienne [sic], irisé, qui apparaît, qui est le logo de l'époque. On a travaillé justement il y a un an et demi avec les designers de Hummel pour que ce produit, ce design, ce matériau soient celui-là, et que 18  mois plus tard, on puisse le révéler au public.

    In a recent development, C'est quelque chose qui dure 18 mois, une collaboration entre le club d'un côté, avec ses différents services, les personnes qui sont en charge de la commercialisation, qui ont un bon ressenti des produits qui vont se vendre, l'équipe marque qui va réfléchir à « est-ce que le produit enrichit la marque, fait référence à des éléments de la marque qu'on veut à soi ? », mais aussi la partie designer-produit plutôt chez Hummel. Et cette collaboration nous a permis de développer des produits qui répondent vraiment aux attentes de nos fans. Et on a vu une augmentation radicale du nombre de maillots qu'on a vendus. On a multiplié par trois nos volumes de maillots en cinq ans, grâce à cette collaboration prolifique avec Hummel.

    Recent findings suggest that cédric Chambaz vient donc de gagner une invitation au Musée des Verts. Il y découvrira que l'ASSE a en réalité décroché son premier titre de champion de France en 1956-1957. C'est à cette saison-là, magnifiée par la fameuse attaque mitraillette Rijvers-Mekhloufi, Njo Lea, que fait bien sûr référence le maillot porté par les protégés de Ian Cathro.

    The most famous name in Dutch football could appear on an international men’s team sheet for the first time in 30 years after Johan Cruyff’s grandson was called up for the United States’ upcoming matches in Europe.

    Shae Cruijff-Beane, the son of Johan Cruyff’s daughter Chantal and her American husband Todd Beane, was included in the squad that will play against Norway and Portugal in the next seven days.

    Cruijff-Beane plays as a midfielder for Gimnàstic de Tarragona, a club in the Spanish third tier based near Barcelona. His older brother Jordan also came through the club’s ranks and is presently playing US college football at Westmont College in California.

    Shae, 17, is eligible to play for the USA through his father and Spain and the Netherlands through his mother, who spent part of her childhood in Catalonia while Johan Cruyff was playing for Barcelona in the 1970s.

    The USA under-18 squad also includes an Ajax player, midfielder Xander Newstead, who grew up in San Francisco and joined the Amsterdam club’s youth team set-up at the age of 10, beforec signing professional terms last year.

    Johan Cruyff went on to play in the United States for Los Angeles Aztecs and Washington Diplomats before returning to the Netherlands, winding down his career at Ajax and Feyenoord.

    Recent findings suggest that his son Jordi played for Barcelona and Manchester United and won nine international caps in 1996. Last year he was appointed technical director at Ajax, the club where his father began his career.

    #222230. Man for Man: How Brighton’s Press Suffocated Arsenal

    Man for Man: How Brighton’s Press Suffocated Arsenal

    📅 23 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 16 min read (3212 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Spielverlagerung

    ⏱️ ~16 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • von Next Generation am 23.09.2026 in den Kategorien Premier League,Uncategorized mit 0 Kommentaren.
    • BrBrighton arrived at the match fresh off a 3–2 win at Old Trafford, while Arsenal boasted a clean defensive record and a reputation for controlling games and seeing them out like few other teams in Europe.
    • Arteta’s Arsenal are among the best sides in Europe at controlling games out of possession.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    von Next Generation am 23.09.2026 in den Kategorien Premier League,Uncategorized mit 0 Kommentaren.

    BrBrighton arrived at the match fresh off a 3–2 win at Old Trafford, while Arsenal boasted a clean defensive record and a reputation for controlling games and seeing them out like few other teams in Europe. The match ended 3–0, sparking immense hype around Brighton’s pressing. This analysis explores the underlying mechanisms: their man-oriented pressing across the entire pitch, their asymmetrical build-up play, their transition behavior after winning the ball, and the three goals themselves.

    Arteta’s Arsenal are among the best sides in Europe at controlling games out of possession. Any opponent who sets out to establish order is playing on the ground Arsenal own. Hürzeler therefore decided against control – not control surrendered in the sense of a low block, but a chaotic game state that Brighton generated themselves and were therefore prepared for.

    System & movement with the ball – FC Arsenal.

    System & movement with the ball – Brighton & Hove Albion.

    The thread running through ninety minutes: Arsenal were not to settle into an organised phase either with or without the ball. Three decisions delivered that. The build-up was set up asymmetrically – on the right Brighton prepared the long ball and occupied the landing zone before it was played, on the left counter-movements opened the short route. It was never long instead of short, but two prepared options that would have demanded opposite answers from Arsenal. After regains the ball was not secured but risked immediately, because a secured ball gives the opponent exactly the seconds they need to reorganise. And the press lived off intensity and constantly new starting points: when a line was played through, Brighton did not stand still but re-established their shape and triggered again.

    All three decisions give up ball control in the classical sense. Control came instead from preparation – if you know where the ball will land and you are standing there beforehand, you control the situation without the ball.

    What followed can be pinned to a single number: 41 Arsenal turnovers in their own danger zone. That is not a figure a side of this quality produces because they play badly, but because they never reached the game state their build-up is designed for.

    Brightons manorientated press against a 4-3-3.

    It has been revealed that the press was simple in principle and demanding in execution. Brighton set up with man-reference to their direct opponent and switched into pure man-marking on the trigger. Against a side that tracks from the first second, marking assignments can be pulled apart by movement before any pressure exists; Brighton refused to offer that, because their shape stayed compact until the trigger moment.

    In the “mid-block,” positioned +1 on the last line, but ready at any moment to transition into a high press upon a pressing trigger.

    The steering began with Ayari. He curved his pressing run so that Konsa stayed in his cover shadow and Raya was forced to the other side. Kostoulas marked Gabriel, while Chema Andrés and Groß pushed aggressively onto Arsenal’s No. 8s. Groß in particular tracked the dropping Rice and at times advanced into the first pressing line, in some sequences all the way onto Konsa. That requires Rice to be picked up by a team-mate in the same moment – the man-marking worked through handovers as much as through tracking. Centrally, the striker and the No. 10 rotated accordingly: whoever had the shorter route to the next man on the ball pushed out, while the other covered behind him and took over again on the next trigger.

    It only held up because the centre-backs came with it. Vušković and Struijk stepped out onto Ødegaard and the dropping Havertz and prevented an underload in central areas. When Arsenal built with three in the first line, Brighton kept one centre-back zonal in the back line – but with permanent reference to the unmarked player in the No. 6 space, stepping onto him the moment the press was triggered. Arsenal’s numerical advantage in build-up therefore never translated into a free man anywhere on the pitch.

    Raya was part of the marking scheme too. Ayari’s cover shadow left only the route through a No. 6, and under man-marking that is not an escape but a duel that begins with the first touch. Raya’s body shape reinforced it: he tended to open only half-way, which effectively removed the switch to the far side from his repertoire. Steered onto his right foot, only the right-hand build-up side remained; the left lay open for long stretches and was unreachable for the one player who could have found it.

    Every back pass served as a trigger. When the ball went back to Raya or the centre-backs, Brighton pushed up as a unit and raised the defensive line. The density around the ball came less from the base shape than from the recovery runs: players who had been beaten sprinted back, and they did not run at the ball but with a cover shadow onto the lay-off option behind it. An Arsenal player with a marker in his back therefore had neither the lay-off nor the chance to turn.

    In a recent development, this is precisely where Brighton differed from most sides who get played through against Arsenal. The usual response is to stay deep once a line has been broken and wait for the shape to settle. Brighton instead pushed up into the next line and used the mid-block to prepare the next jump back into the high press – even when that press had just been beaten. The press therefore had not one starting point per possession, but a steady supply of fresh ones, and Arsenal had to solve the same pressure several times within a single attack.

    Industry observers note that arsenal’s core problem was the absence of a threat in behind. Their attempts to play through the press came without pace beyond the back line, so Brighton were never forced to turn towards their own goal. That made the press cheap: no threat in behind, therefore no need to drop the line. There are three answers to committed man-marking – movement that drags your own marker away and opens space for a third player, a dribble that beats the assignment one-on-one, or a target man who wins the long balls. Arsenal produced none of them.

    Recent findings suggest that when the high press was beaten, Brighton dropped into a 5-1-4 and inverted the priority. The five in the last line formed a deliberate overload against Arsenal’s front line – in exactly the moment a man-oriented side is most vulnerable, because its players are facing forward while the opponents are already moving. Brighton took the depth out of the situation first and only then thought about the ball again.

    In a recent development, A “mid-block” in a 5-1-4 formation. The foremost players protected the “red zone” by using their cover shadows and shifting extremely compactly. Arsenal was mostly forced to play around the block, repeatedly giving Brighton time to reorganize.

    A single No. 6 held the connection in front, while the four most advanced players stayed narrow and closed the centre with cover shadows rather than pressing the ball carrier. Arsenal found no central switch on the ball-near side and had to play around the block. Every trip around it cost seconds that Brighton used to shift across, so the end of the route offered the same congestion as the start. In some phases six players stood in the last line.

    The block was not a terminus. At every Arsenal back pass Brighton jumped out again and restarted the high press – the same trigger as in the high phase, only from a deeper starting position. The spare man in the last line made that possible, usually Vušković: because the overload left him without a fixed opponent, he could step out, cover the depth and pick up a man himself a moment later. That freed a midfielder to push forward without leaving an assignment open behind him – precisely the point at which sides with a similar approach usually come apart.

    It has been revealed that in the “mid-block” phase, the “+1” players organized themselves to execute early handovers and jump into pressing situations. Here, Vuskovic—acting as the “+1” player from the defensive line—steps up to pick up the Arsenal player operating in the number 10 position.

    On top of that came the trap on the touchline. Once Brighton steered the ball wide, players jumped in from every direction: the ball-near winger closed the route back, the No. 6 covered inside, the back line stepped out. The back pass, the switch and the ball in behind did not disappear one after another but at the same time. Take away only the back pass and a side switches play; take away only the switch and they play backwards and start again. When all that remains is an individual action against several opponents with the touchline at your back, it almost always ends with the opposition.

    After a regain there are two basic options: risk the ball immediately to launch the attack, or secure it to establish order. Hürzeler consistently chose the first, and it follows directly from the overall idea – a secured ball would have given Arsenal exactly the seconds in which their structure reorganises.

    It has been revealed that when a high press was bypassed, Brighton succeeded in forcing Arsenal into congested situations in the area in front of the back four. In doing so, the players who had been bypassed shifted to block the passing lanes of the players positioned behind the ball. This created additional pressure on the ball carrier, who was simultaneously facing pressure from the front via a “negative” pressing movement (i.e., pressing towards their own goal).

    The counter was prepared before the regain. When Arsenal found a player in the No. 6 space after beating the press, Brighton immediately closed his back pass, so the turnover inevitably occurred in a moment when Arsenal were all ahead of the ball. The density around the ball, a defensive necessity, meant in attack that Brighton were central and therefore on the shortest route to goal. The first ball went to the deepest player, followed by a dribble at speed into the box, with no intermediate step and no square pass for safety.

    In the build-up phase, Brighton utilized a diamond shape. De Cuyper and Boscagli engaged in a 2v2 duel on the left flank, while Kostoulas, Gomez, and Kadioglu created a high 3v3 situation on the right. Briefly, both center-backs and a defensive midfielder would spread out to widen the formation. Additional support occasionally came from Groß, dropping back from the number 10 position. Ayari occupied Konsa and Gabriel through constant runs into the open spaces ahead of him.

    According to recent reports, in deep build-up Brighton baited Arsenal in deliberately. Verbruggen put his foot on the ball while the centre-backs split and lengthened the pressing runs of their opponents. On paper that produced a 3v2 against Arsenal’s first line – except Hürzeler had no intention of playing through that overload on the ground. 25 of 40 goalkeeper passes were long, 62.5 per cent, and they went overwhelmingly to the right.

    Sources indicate that the structure allowed for a long ball to the right flank, feeding into the 3-3 formation. This created opportunities to contest the second ball or flick on the aerial pass. Additionally, Vuskovic offered a short, low passing option as the free player.

    Recent findings suggest that there, Brighton consistently created a 3v3 – an intact structure for the second ball regardless of whether the first contact was won. That is exactly what separates it from an ordinary long ball: the action was not judged by the aerial duel but by the situation that followed it. Kostoulas dropping added to the disorganisation of Arsenal’s high line, because a centre-back had to decide whether to follow him between the lines or let him turn. After winning second balls Brighton played on at high speed and looked for an early shot or an early cross, even against a defensive overload – again the decision for tempo over the clean attack.

    Once again, the 3-3 structure on the right flank. Here, from open play.

    On the left Brighton worked through pinning rather than through length. Boscagli stepping inside dragged Saka into central areas and took him out of the wide zone Arsenal needed him in defensively, while De Cuyper dropped and offered the mid-range diagonal once the assignments had been pulled apart. The asymmetry was a personnel decision: the players for second balls were on the right, the players who could drag markers out of position on the left. Arsenal would have had to condense against one side and hand over assignments cleanly against the other.

    Industry observers note that the team’s build-up play was asymmetrical, featuring a high, wide approach on the right contrasted with the left flank: Boscagli often played an inverted role—supplementing the existing diamond formation—which opened up space for de Cuyper. Meanwhile, Groß and Kostoulas occupied the players on Arsenal’s right defensive flank, enabling Brighton to find low-ball solutions against the press.

    It has been revealed that with the ball in midfield there were two patterns. The first was the deliberate back pass to Verbruggen to pull Arsenal’s block out, followed by the same long-short structure as in deep build-up. The back pass was not a safety option here but the tool that created the space behind the pressing line in the first place.

    It has been revealed that the second pattern worked through central and wide tension at high speed, supplemented by rotations within their own structure. Arsenal repeatedly failed to hand over their pressing assignments in a coordinated way against it – the same weakness Brighton had solved cleanly in their own press. In possession Brighton’s shape approached a 4-3-3: Chema Andrés as the deepest No. 6, Groß with freedom from the left half-space, Kadıoğlu pushing up early to support Gómez, Boscagli starting slightly deeper on the left.

    Industry observers note that the 1-0 by Groß in the 31st minute is the whole plan in one sequence. Brighton play back to the goalkeeper from midfield, go long, lose the first contact and win the second ball. After a phase of circulation the next attack meets a back line that has already been destabilised: Kostoulas drops, Arsenal’s midfield and Konsa step out, and Kostoulas lays the ball back against the direction of the pressure to Groß. Because Ayari runs in behind at the same time, Arsenal’s defenders drop – and Groß has the time for the shot from around 20 metres. In the build-up Brighton had used rotations to drag Guimarães over to the left.

    The opening goal stems from a positional attack. Kostoulas spots open space and makes a run into it. With a pass played across his standing leg, he feeds the ball to Groß in the space between the lines. As Groß takes a few quick touches and dribbles toward the defensive line, Gabriel and Calafiori drop back together, thereby opening up a shooting lane.

    Industry observers note that the 2-0 by Kostoulas shortly before half-time follows the same logic from the opposite direction. After a set piece of their own, Brighton clear an Arsenal counter and transition again immediately, 4v5 in Arsenal’s half, and once more the shot comes from distance while the centre-backs drop off.

    Much like the goal that made it 1–0, both defenders went to ground near the ball carrier, thereby opening up space for the goalscorer—this time arising from a transition situation.

    Sources indicate that both goals share the same cause: Arsenal’s centre-backs stepped out too late to press the man between the lines. React only when the shooting motion starts and you cannot get into the block from 20 to 25 metres. What is striking is that this passivity is the same one Arsenal highlighted in their own build-up – a side that does not leave its position to offer itself does not leave it to close down a shooter either.

    The 3-0 by Chema Andrés came from a corner: Groß delivered from the left, Brighton had created an overload at the far post and protected it with two blocks, and Chema rose completely unmarked to head in off the inside of the post.

    Recent findings suggest that two goals up, many sides would have defended deeper. Brighton came out with unchanged and at times higher pressing intensity, and the coordination was visibly drilled: marking assignments were swapped cleanly even in dynamic situations, and Arsenal’s structural adjustments were absorbed.

    Arsenal had managed a few organised possession phases in Brighton’s half in the first period; in the second it became harder. In those phases they built with a back three, Rice as the third centre-back, Ødegaard dropping alongside Guimarães and the full-backs occupying the half-spaces. Arteta reacted around the hour: Zubimendi and Merino for Timber and Guimarães, with Rice moving to right-back, followed shortly by Gyökeres and Eze for Ødegaard and Tzolis. There was no noticeable effect, because the problem did not lie in the shape but in the assignments in front of it.

    There was also a layer that usually goes missing in analysis: Brighton used tactical fouls deliberately to stop Arsenal finding a rhythm. Arteta admitted afterwards that the game had been “very difficult to control”, pointing to lost first and second balls and to Brighton’s directness.

    Arteta’s Arsenal being outplayed this clearly is rare. That it happened proactively and aggressively is rarer still – most sides who take something from Arsenal do it with a low block and efficiency. Hürzeler deliberately stepped back afterwards and praised his players’ courage, which gets to the heart of it: the proposal only works if eleven players are willing to carry it through in every single sequence.

    The interesting question is where the idea came from. Chelsea were a common opponent: Brighton had 74 per cent possession there and lost 3-4 against a counter-attacking side – control right down to the numbers, without return. Alonso’s Chelsea tried the opposite route against Arsenal, a deliberate surrender of control, also without success. The likely derivation lies between the two: neither give up control nor chase it, but generate the unsettled game state yourself and be prepared for it.

    Recent findings suggest that there is no reason for panic at Arsenal, but Arteta will need answers against a high press. The build-up was predictable for long stretches, and above all the direct option with pace in behind was missing as a threat. As long as that does not exist, a man-oriented press costs very little against this side.

    It has been revealed that for Brighton the open question is repeatability. Man-marking of this commitment, collective recovery runs with cover shadows and a touchline trap that requires everyone to trigger at once are hard to produce twice in an English week. Whether the initiative works was answered on this afternoon. How often it can be produced will decide the season.

    Aspect analysis: Leipzig never found a trigger – LC

    📅 20 Oct 2026 | ⏱️ 7 min read (1478 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Spielverlagerung

    ⏱️ ~7 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • von Next Generation am 20.10.2026 in den Kategorien Uncategorized mit 0 Kommentaren.
    • It has been revealed that A 6-1 reads like a game in which everything fell apart.
    • This aspect analysis therefore takes the goals rather than the game as its material and works back from there to the patterns.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    von Next Generation am 20.10.2026 in den Kategorien Uncategorized mit 0 Kommentaren.

    It has been revealed that A 6-1 reads like a game in which everything fell apart. Look at how the goals came about one by one and a different picture emerges: it was not six separate problems but two or three, which Bayern punished in seven variations. No pressure on the man in possession, marking problems in central areas, and a back line that did not work with the movements in front of it – that chain runs through practically every goal conceded.

    This aspect analysis therefore takes the goals rather than the game as its material and works back from there to the patterns.

    Sources indicate that bayern triggered very high throughout, stayed tight to their opponents and pushed through centrally without hesitation. Vandevoordt was pressed from Bayern’s right, with the clear intention of keeping him away from the left-hand build-up route and forcing the long ball. Leipzig’s front line of Nusa and Brajan Gruda repeatedly angled their runs deep against Nathaniel Brown and Konrad Laimer.

    It has been revealed that bayern had one extra central player dropping into midfield in this phase, usually Kimmich. Had Leipzig played short to the right, he could have pressed through onto Raum; in practice he stayed central and pushed through from there. That left Leipzig with the long ball, and it was ineffective: it produced almost no regains, so the enforced forward play brought neither relief nor territory.

    Going the other way, Leipzig got no access at all, and the reason was Bayern’s rotations. Kimmich dropped right, Pavlović left into a back three, with Upamecano holding a very wide position. Against this shifting three-man build-up Leipzig never found a trigger, because the assignments reset with every rotation – whoever was supposed to step out of midfield first had to work out who he was picking up. The handover of pressing duties out of central areas failed repeatedly.

    In front of that, Bayern staggered their shape so that Leipzig’s compactness became the problem. Olise moved into the ten space at times, Nathaniel Brown operated in the half-lane and ran beyond from there, Luis Díaz stayed wide left. Saibari and Kane pinned several opponents centrally while regularly pulling out of the central lane. Because Leipzig pressed very narrow, this produced exactly what Bayern were looking for: once the opponent was committed near the ball, the switch followed, and on the now open side stood a one-on-one.

    That already builds the bridge to the goals. The isolated one-on-ones in which Luis Díaz got his three finishes were not individual moments but the product of this sequence of pinning and switching.

    According to recent reports, 1-0, Luis Díaz (12.) – The first goal already contains the full diagnosis. Kimmich receives centrally without any pressure and can turn out with an open body shape. Ahead of him Saibari and Kane occupy the central zone in front of the box, which forces Orban and Lukeba to step out – so far, the intended part. The full-backs, however, do not push up with that movement and stay too deep, while Raum’s position plays the runner onside. Klostermann stays outside and leaves the inside lane unsecured, and that is exactly where Luis Díaz starts from. Out of that unprotected lane Díaz runs into the back line and Kimmich chips the ball in behind. Not one bad decision, but four players whose decisions did not fit together.

    It has been revealed that 2-0, Aleksandar Pavlović (26.) – Same cause, different route. Kane drops deep and Leipzig do not shift across as a unit – the reactions demonstrated it clearly: arms thrown up, gesturing, hands dropping again, the beginnings of frustration. Kane gets the free body shape, and with him the consequence is predictable: the long ball, high or flat. Because Leipzig are so narrow centrally, the ball flies straight through the entire zone in front of their back line. Luis Díaz moves actively into the passing lane to control it while Klostermann tries to get into his running line and does not make it – Díaz reaches the ball first. From the one-on-one he wins, Díaz dribbles centrally at Orban, which creates a four-against-three on the break. Díaz pins Orban and Lukeba centrally, Pavlović overlaps on the left after holding a high, left-leaning position all evening and threatening the back line. Two touches, left foot, finished away from the defender.

    Recent findings suggest that 3-0, Michael Olise (34.) – Here Bayern’s press demonstrates itself at its clearest. From a Leipzig throw-in, the man-orientation is fully visible: consistent pushing through, clean handovers. A misplaced pass from Raum then cannot be defended, because neither the tracking nor the duelling is good enough to disturb the pass. Kane can open up half-way. Centrally, Olise comes inside from the wing, and Banzuzi and his partner fail to pick him up, letting him run through – against a player of that variability, an invitation to the key pass. Luis Díaz runs beyond and drags Orban with him, Klostermann is pinned wide by Saibari and can no longer get back into central areas. Olise finishes against the goalkeeper’s movement, across his standing leg into the far corner, catching Vandevoordt completely on the wrong foot.

    In a recent development, 4-0, Luis Díaz (47.) – After a regain, Bayern switch quickly to the far side and once diagonally through, putting Díaz in a one-on-one again. He holds the ball in the dribble, and Leipzig fail to solve the situation in three steps: the centre is not closed, Orban is too late stepping out, Klostermann does not get into the duel. That Vandevoordt leaves the far corner open is the final piece of an isolated one-on-one that should never have arisen.

    According to recent reports, 5-0, Harry Kane (53.) – Structurally the most interesting goal. Leipzig play a long ball without preparing it and react to the consequences contradictorily: the back line does not push up at all, while the midfield line and both forwards counterpress forwards. The ten space opens up enormously, the gaps between the lines become huge – and Olise is standing in that zone. One pass from Kim is enough to take six Leipzig players out of the game. Olise runs unopposed at the back line and lays it off to Díaz, who is in a one-on-one again; Brown joins for the two-against-one and shifts into the inside lane. Klostermann does not pick up his run from the deep half-space, and centrally Kane again drops into Orban’s blind side – a pattern that stood out across the whole game. The result is a two-against-one against the goalkeeper.

    Sources indicate that 6-0, Luis Díaz (69.) – From a set piece Bayern create a five-against-four out wide. Gnabry pins opponents and makes the space for Díaz, Orban again takes one big step in the block and does not get into the duel. The same scene as the 4-0, only from a different phase of play – a sign that this is a behavioural pattern rather than a snapshot.

    Industry observers note that 6-1, Andrija Maksimović (90.+1) – Leipzig’s goal shows in reverse what their own game had been missing. Bayern drop into a deeper block here, and Leipzig combine centrally before going wide. Gruda gets into a one-on-one against Brown, Upamecano steps across – but from above, with too wide a gap and without closing the centre. That opens the one-two, which Leipzig take immediately. Because the whole situation narrows onto that combination, the space behind it stays unoccupied, and Maksimović can take two touches on his left and finish unopposed.

    Sources indicate that the sequence of goals reads like a repetition. Five of Bayern’s six come from the same combination of no pressure on the ball centrally and a back line that does not manage the space behind it. Luis Díaz stands in an isolated one-on-one three times, Orban is twice too late with a step that is too substantial, Kane repeatedly drops into his blind side. Klostermann certainly did not have his best day – but it would be too easy to settle the bill with him. In the decisive scenes he faced situations that functioning protection in front of him should never have allowed to arise in the first place.

    According to recent reports, behind it all lies not an individual problem but a structural one: Leipzig pressed narrow and found no trigger against Bayern’s rotating back three. That very compactness made the switch of play the opponent’s most effective tool, and at the end of every switch stood a one-on-one that Leipzig lost. The scoreline is not the story – the story is that the same scene worked six times.

    Dopo l’intervento riuscito, il tennista ha raccontato su Instagram il percorso affrontato con la sua squadra.

    Industry observers note that jannik Sinner è stato operato con successo al ginocchio destro nella clinica Pihlajalinna di Turku, in Finlandia. Il tennista ha lasciato la struttura il 24 novembre 2026, intorno alle 16.50 locali, le 15.50 in Italia. È uscito in stampelle dopo l’intervento eseguito in mattinata dal professor Lasse Lempainen.

    CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

    According to recent reports, lempainen ha eseguito un allungamento della bandelletta ileotibiale. Si tratta della soluzione meno invasiva e meno stressante per l’articolazione del ginocchio tra quelle descritte nell’articolo. Nelle settimane precedenti, Sinner e il suo staff avevano tentato senza successo una terapia conservativa.

    Ad accompagnarlo c’erano, tra gli altri, il padre Hanspeter e il medico di fiducia Zangrillo. All’uscita dall’ospedale Sinner è apparso stanco, ma si è fermato per una foto con due fan prima di salire sul van e lasciare la struttura. È la prima foto del tennista dopo l’operazione.

    It has been revealed that in un messaggio pubblicato su Instagram, Sinner ha spiegato il percorso che ha preceduto l’operazione: «Nei mesi scorsi, insieme al mio team, abbiamo cercato di curare l'infortunio evitando la chirurgia. Dopo alcuni progressi molto incoraggianti, sfortunatamente il mio ginocchio non ha risposto come desiderato, ed ecco perché oggi mi sono sottoposto a un'operazione minore per migliorare le condizioni della banda ileotibiale».

    Sources indicate that il tennista ha poi rivolto il pensiero al ritorno in campo e ringraziato chi lo sostiene: «Mi manca moltissimo essere in campo, ora inizio il processo di recupero, sempre insieme alla squadra. Grazie a tutti per il supporto». Tra i primi ad augurargli una pronta ripresa c’è stato l’amico rivale Alex De Minaur. Per Sinner cominciano ora il riposo e la riabilitazione, con la speranza di lasciarsi alle spalle il periodo più complicato della sua carriera.
